title: ENG-205 Sir Gawain Part 3 — 4 Main Ideas
subject: ENG-205

cards.def: Still hiding the girdle from Bertilak, Gawain sets out on New Year's Day and refuses his guide's offer to let him run away, saying he would be "christened a coward."
At the Green Chapel the Green Knight fakes the first swing when Gawain flinches, holds back on the second, and only nicks Gawain's neck with the third.
The Green Knight reveals he is the castle's lord and that the two harmless swings repaid Gawain's two honest trades, while the nick punished the girdle Gawain hid to save his life.
Ashamed of his cowardice and broken promise, Gawain confesses and the Green Knight forgives him, but Gawain chooses to wear the girdle forever as a reminder of his sin.
The Green Knight then names himself Bertilak and explains that Morgan le Fay, Gawain's aunt who learned magic from Merlin, sent him to test the Round Table's pride and frighten Guinevere.
When Gawain returns and confesses everything, Arthur's court laughs and every knight takes up a green sash for Gawain's sake, turning his sign of shame into a badge of honor.
